title: SalesQualificationOutput
description: Structured output contract for the Sales Qualification Agent. The n8n AI Agent node's Structured Output Parser uses this shape directly — the model must return exactly this, nothing more.

problem.description: The repetitive/manual work the prospect described, in their words, not embellished.

lead_sources.description: Where the prospect said their own leads come from, if mentioned.

missing_information.description: Field names still unknown, e.g. ["budget", "timeline"]. Never fabricate a value instead of listing it here.

intent.description: One short phrase, e.g. "AI automation for lead follow-up".

recommended_reply.description: The next message to send the prospect. Asks 1-2 of the most important missing questions, never all of them at once.

next_action.description: One concrete next step, e.g. "Send recommended_reply and wait for budget/timeline".

human_review_required.description: True if this conversation has reached a point requiring a human: a price/contract commitment, a refund, a request the agent cannot ethically or accurately answer, or the prospect explicitly asking for a human.
